lessons.lesson: Do not start a second full pytest run while another is in the background, and do not kill processes by matching a string that also appears in your own command line; there is no pkill or curl in this image, so save the server PID when starting it
lessons.when: Stopping a temporary uvicorn server or running the long suite in the background
lessons.evidence: A /proc scan for 'port 8493' killed the background pytest; two overlapping full runs made test_AC_42 exceed its 5 s timing limit
